title: Stage 1b — ADT validator: exhaustiveness + well-formed field/variant access + is + cage

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content: Stage 1b: replace the 1a UnsupportedAdt validator gate with the real ADT validator in thermite-spec/src/validator.rs. Declaration pre-pass (Validator::new) collects enums (name->variant order), variant_to_enum, struct_fields. REQ-5 check_match_exhaustiveness infers the matched enum from arm patterns and emits NonExhaustiveMatch{missing}/UnreachableArm/UnknownVariant; slice/Option matches inert (no regression). REQ-6 check_field/check_variant_ref emit UnknownField/UnknownVariant. REQ-7: Match/Field/Is/Deref stay flat built-ins in the caged walk. New SpecError variants additive. Tests: thermite-spec/tests/adt_validate.rs drives conformance/adt-validate/cases.json (3 accept, 5 reject). Gauntlet: build/test/clippy/fmt all green; lowering stays gated (1c).

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content: SHIPPED + critic-clean (5f5a4b7 validator, 9294377 the #66 fix). The real ADT validator: declaration pre-pass (enum variant sets + struct field sets), exhaustiveness (NonExhaustiveMatch/UnreachableArm), well-formed field/variant access (UnknownField/UnknownVariant), is-discrimination, the cage interaction (match/Field/is flat built-ins). 3 ADT programs validate clean; 5 reject cases yield exact errors. Critic found+fixed #66 (CRITICAL: exhaustiveness bypassable via a lowercase variant — the parser's case-based pattern disambiguation was unsound; closed by mandating UpperCamelCase variants [REQ-2 amended] + InvalidVariantCasing rejection in the pre-pass, whole-class). workspace 440 tests, thermite-spec ZERO failures. ADT programs now validate + effect-check + gate at LOWERING. Next: 1c lowering (the last gate) -> ADTs certify L3.
